Hi, moving forward with managing the DSM in R, I have a question regarding the grid of covariables for predicting after fitting a DSM.

I copy here the preddata coming from mexdolphins: 


I understand that latitude, longitud, w and y represents coordinates for the "center" of the cell, but wonder what means width and height..... width and heights in meters of each cell?  makes sense as the width changs slightly from cell to cell beacuse they come from geographic coordinates.

I believed that the size of the cell was taken into account by the "offset"....

Thanks for any advice

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Grid for prediction in DSM module for R
parts:
Adrian:

The fields "width" and "height" in the prediction grid are as you describe.  Their only use in the mexdolphin analysis is for plotting purposes; they are not otherwise involved in calculations.  Likewise, cell size is calculated in the code and assigned to the object "off.set".
